name: Wanosuchus
isnote: Described as a sebecosuchian mesoeucrocodylian (English Wikipedia) but PBDB places it in Eusuchia; placed in Eusuchia.
sum: Wanosuchus is a crocodyliform known only from a nearly complete lower jaw from the Paleocene of southern Anhui, China.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: IVPP V 6262, a nearly complete lower jaw, Anhui, China.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Zhang 1981

sources.text: F. Zhang. 1981. A fossil crocodile from Anhui Province. Vertebrata PalAsiatica 19(3):200-207
